title: The Method of Ellipcenters for Strongly Convex Functions
summary: The Method of Ellipcenters (ME), introduced in~\cite{ME2025} for strongly convex quadratic minimization, uses two gradient evaluations per iteration: one at the current iterate and one at a companion point on the same level set. We extend ME to the broader class of strongly convex functions with Lipschitz continuous gradient.
